default.notes: Visitor visa (TRV, CAD 100 plus CAD 85 biometrics) required; apply online well in advance — processing can take weeks to months.

groups.notes: eTA (CAD 7, valid up to 5 years) required when flying to Canada; arriving by land or sea from the US needs only your passport. Stays of up to 6 months are normally granted.

Can fly to Canada with just an eTA ONLY if they have held a Canadian visa in the past 10 years or currently hold a valid US non-immigrant visa; everyone else needs a visitor visa (TRV). Check your eligibility on canada.ca before booking.

US.notes: US citizens need neither a visa nor an eTA — just a valid US passport (or equivalent document at land crossings). Stays of up to 6 months are normally granted.
